h1: Best window cleaners in Leeds: 3 local window cleaning firms
checks: Ask whether the window cleaner has public liability insurance.
Ask how often they will come and how you pay, and whether frames and sills are included.
For high windows, ask whether they use water fed poles from the ground or ladders.

p: Traditional window cleaning uses a squeegee and ladders where needed. It gets into corners well and suits small panes and leaded lights.

Water fed pole cleaning uses purified water pumped up a long pole from the ground. It cleans frames and sills as well as glass, avoids ladders and dries without smears. Most Leeds rounds now use poles for upper floors.

guide.h2: How often should windows be cleaned?
p: Most homes in Leeds have their windows cleaned every four to eight weeks. Homes on busy roads, near building work or under trees may need more frequent cleans. Many window cleaners offer a regular round and send a text before each visit.

Many window cleaners also clear gutters and clean conservatory roofs and fascias. Blocked gutters are a common cause of damp in Leeds' older houses, so clearing them once or twice a year is worth it. See damp proofing in Leeds if water is already getting in.

guide.h2: Questions to ask a window cleaner
ul: Are you insured, and can I see proof?
How often will you come, and do you text before visiting?
Are frames, sills and doors included?
How do I pay, and what happens if I am out?
Do you clean conservatory roofs and gutters?

faqs.q: How much does a window cleaner cost in Leeds?
faqs.a: Prices depend on the number of windows and access. Ask for a fixed price per clean. Our window cleaner cost guide is coming in a later update.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home for the window cleaner?
faqs.a: Usually not for outside windows, as long as they can reach the back of the house. Agree how you will pay.

faqs.q: Is water fed pole cleaning as good as traditional?
faqs.a: For most windows, yes. Purified water dries without streaks and the frames get cleaned too. Traditional cleaning can be better for small panes and leaded windows.

faqs.q: Can window cleaners clean conservatory roofs?
faqs.a: Many can, using poles and soft brushes. Ask whether it is included or priced separately.
